summary: Confirmed bounded execution reuse of the frozen source-pixel adapter and unchanged composition: one supported fixed HeritagePark trial, two composition calls, all3stations x3widths retained. Scientific paired-ribbon expectation FALSIFIED: all9 crop fits and all9 full-source fits are null. Sensor contrast is partial only: ribbon combined[0,.688889,.340741] vs both controls[0,0,0]. Calibrated width and semantic identity remain UNKNOWN.

limitations: No retuning, recentering, altered crop/window/settings or second actual run.
Profiles average48 longitudinal positions, not per-position paired-edge proof.
Nearest sensor and bilinear averaged profile are different sampling channels; no AA claim.
Raw numeric width and positive sensor contrast do not establish path identity, renderer provenance, physical scale or calibrated width.
No heldout independence; source/testimony inspected before geometry freeze and geometry messages exposed to adapter author.
Positive sensor contrast and diagnostic learner30 do not establish a two-edge fit or accepted ribbon.
One actual adapter invocation only; missing /usr/bin/time failed before Node launch, retained Python wrapper supplied resource observations.
Figure rerendered for layout from same receipt only; no score recomputation or second trial.
No repo edits, Git mutations, CV source changes, HH work, calibration or AA muting.
